title: 我早就放手了
mood: giddy, falling for her three laps in
subject: teaching a twenty-six-year-old to ride a shared bike in an empty supermarket car park at night, and letting go of the seat three laps before she notices
caption: Mandarin melodic future-bass EDM pop in the build-and-drop style of current Chinese festival electronic music. Detuned supersaw chord stacks pumping hard against a sidechained kick; future-bass chord stabs with an LFO wobbling the filter and the volume; a bright detuned synth lead carrying the melody in each drop; a deep 808 sub under the chords; half-time drop drums with the clap on three and trap-style hi-hat rolls, a snare-roll riser and white-noise sweep into every drop, and a breakdown that falls back to solo piano. Close and intimate in the verses, wide and pumping in the drops, the voice forward and the supersaws spread wide behind it. Male voice, a clean close-miked tenor with breath in it, soft in the verses and opening up in the chorus. 150 BPM with a half-time feel, F major. Giddy, falling for her three laps in. No four-on-the-floor house kick, no 80s analog synthpop, no rap verse, no trap beat under the verses, no chopped-up voice snippets in the drops, no guitar, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Intro - short, solo piano with a filtered supersaw swelling underneath]

[Verse 1]
超市關門以後 停車場只剩一排路燈
妳掃了一台共享單車 說今天一定要學會
二十六歲 第一次騎 手抓得比握方向盤還緊
我在後面扶著坐墊 跑得比妳還喘

[Pre-Chorus - snare roll builds]
妳一直喊 不要放手 不要放手
我說好 我在 我在後面

[Chorus]
我早就放手了
從B區騎到C區 妳一個人騎了三圈
妳還在喊不要放手 頭都不敢回
我站在原地 突然捨不得叫妳

[Drop - half-time supersaw stabs, a bright synth lead plays the chorus melody]

[Verse 2]
妳終於回頭 看見我在三十公尺外
車頭一歪 直直撞進那一排購物車
保全拿著手電筒 從另一頭跑過來
妳坐在地上笑 說 你騙我

[Pre-Chorus - snare roll builds]
妳問我 你什麼時候放的
我說 第二圈 妳開始哼歌的時候

[Chorus]
我早就放手了
從B區騎到C區 妳一個人騎了三圈
妳拍拍膝蓋上的灰 說明天還要再來
我站在原地 這一次 換我放不下了

[Drop - half-time supersaw stabs and synth lead]

[Outro - solo piano, the supersaw fading]
停車場的燈 一盞一盞關了
妳伸手過來 說 這次換你不要放手
